Gallery

The property, through the year.

Twelve views of a mile of bluff. The light here changes more than the buildings do, which is why most of these are really pictures of weather.

Every image on this site is original generated artwork rather than photography — the compositions are built from the same coastal vocabulary as the rest of the design, and no stock library or third-party licence is involved.

It is better in person.

Particularly in the second week of January, when nobody believes us.
